title: Stagwell Schedules Webcast to Discuss Financial Results for the Three and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK CITY, NY /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / October 8, 2026 /**[Stagwell](https://pr.report/s5n1)


[(NASDAQ:STGW)](https://pr.report/s5n2) , the global challenger network transforming marketing through AI, will report financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, on Thursday, October 29, 2026, before market open.


Stagwell will host a video webcast to review those results the same day at 8:30 AM (ET). Register[here](https://pr.report/s5n3) to attend the webcast.


A replay of the webcast will be available following the event at Stagwell’s website,[https://www.stagwellglobal.com/investors/](https://www.stagwellglobal.com/investors/)[.](https://pr.report/s5n4)


**About Stagwell**
Stagwell is the global challenger network transforming marketing through AI. We deliver scaled creative performance for the world’s most ambitious brands, connecting culture-moving creativity with leading-edge technology to harmonize the art and science of marketing. Led by entrepreneurs, our specialists in 40+ countries are unified under a single purpose: to drive effectiveness and improve business results for our clients. Join us at[www.stagwellglobal.com](https://pr.report/s5n5) .
